svg.text: AI Cyber Account Lab
Result:
HIGH RISK
Password (sample): very weak (0/4) — known common password!
• Mix lowercase and uppercase letters.
• Add numbers and a symbol.
• Avoid common words and patterns like 'password' or '123456'.
URL risk: 6
• Host is a raw IP address instead of a domain name.
• Link does not use HTTPS.
• Many subdomains can hide the real domain.
• URL contains '@', which can hide the real destination.
Login — AI anomaly score: 3.365
• Login from a country outside the usual profile.
• Login from a device outside the usual profile.
• Login time is far from the usual time of day.
• Login in the deep-night window for this account.
• Several failed login attempts before this login.
Hardening actions
• Turn on 2FA, preferably with an authenticator app or security key.
• Use a password manager so every account gets a unique password.
• Update your recovery email/phone and save backup codes offline.
